summary: For Georgia, pair patient quarterback decisions with sound protection and disciplined pressure. Follow the final availability report before assuming the offensive line is settled.

items.headline: DeBoer is optimistic about James; a return is not confirmed
items.tldr: Monday’s update left his availability open. Check the final report before assuming he will reclaim the right-tackle job.

items.headline: Russell threw for 285 yards and three touchdowns at Mississippi State
items.tldr: His decision-making is the useful part to carry forward. Watch him take the available receiver before trying to extend a play against Georgia.

items.headline: Griffin led Alabama with nine tackles off the bench
items.tldr: Tuesday’s national freshman award recognizes his Mississippi State performance. Watch assignment discipline along with the tackle totals.

items.headline: Alabama is monitoring the weather; no game change is announced
items.tldr: The school says it currently has no plans to alter Saturday’s Georgia game. Check official updates before traveling; a possible change is not a confirmed postponement.

items.headline: Georgia has used the same starting offensive line in every game
items.tldr: The opponent’s preview highlights continuity up front. Watch the pressure arrive without opening an escape lane or losing a receiver behind it.

lead.headline: Protect the next play.
lead.body: Take the useful throw, protect the ball through contact and keep pressure connected to coverage. A short field still needs a clean finish.
